compactMembership.notes: Colorado's electrician reciprocity operates via NERA (National Electrical Reciprocal Alliance) bylaws — a voluntary multi-state reciprocity ARRANGEMENT that still requires applying for and being issued a separate Colorado license, NOT a single multistate license practiced across member states without a new license (the defining feature of a true compact, e.g. the Nurse Licensure Compact). Recorded as false to avoid conflating NERA with a compact under this field's actual schema meaning.

reciprocityRules.notes: Verbatim quotation from the official Colorado State Electrical Board regulation text (3 CCR 710-1) — the single highest-confidence finding across the entire Phase 2D research pass. Confirmed as a full, unconditional exclusion: the official DORA Applications page's 'Electrician Licensure By Reciprocity' section addresses Journeyman only, with no Master pathway of any kind mentioned.

endorsementRules.notes: No Master-level endorsement pathway was identified as existing in Phase 2D.1/2D.2 research — reciprocity is confirmed excluded, and no alternative named pathway (endorsement, ULR, etc.) was found or confirmed absent.
